title: 2009 Prairie checked against Monroe's 1896 drawing
items: Nothing you can see changed in the scene: the Meyer house at 2009 Prairie now has a camera for Harriet Monroe's 1896 pen drawing, so it is checked against that picture as well as the photograph.

The drawing lines up with the house as built, gable, oriel, door and stoop. Both pictures show the course over the oriel sloping down toward the south, so that is recorded as the next thing to settle.
